name: Atlas Arcade
summary: Three repeated geometric arches organize a broad Maghrebi mosque beneath a stepped cornice and one square minaret.
why: Three doorway axes at x=41, 54, and 67 repeat at an exact 13-unit pitch. Their peaks all meet y=58 and their piers share y=72. One connected architectural silhouette includes the minaret, hall, and cornice; the gold roof trim is attached directly to the hall.
risk: The broad arcade and square minaret emphasize regional mosque architecture. At 24px the three openings read as a measured architectural rhythm.
sub2: Deco restraint with a Maghrebi outline
reasonToChoose: You want a confident Maghrebi identity with restrained geometric detail.
